commands.command: read quality.yml backend-tests and the job log of a green run
commands.notes: Finding: backend-tests ran 'go test -race ./...' with only a Redis service on 26316 and no PANTHEON_TEST_DSN, so every testmysql test skipped in the required gate (T04's migration tests, T14's, credential scope, async recovery). Generic testredis tests skipped too: only the observability-specific address was set.

commands.command: go test ./... on clean main with PANTHEON_TEST_DSN (local MySQL 8, maintainer-authorized), loc=UTC, server in UTC+8
commands.notes: TestMarkHostResultDefersTerminalTaskUntilActiveAttemptFinishes fails with business.deploy.taskHost.staleReport. Not a product bug: the code compares lease_expires_at (written by Go as UTC) with CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) in SQL, so a server clock that is not UTC makes a fresh lease look expired. With loc=Local on the same server the test passes; with the DSN pinned to UTC and a UTC session clock it passes. Production and testmysql default to loc=Local when the DSN has no loc. CI therefore needs a UTC MySQL, not Asia/Shanghai.

commands.command: go test ./modules/business/... with a UTC session clock (DSN time_zone='+00:00'), -timeout 70m -p 3
commands.notes: Simulation of the CI service. 26 packages ok, including deploy (1500s locally, about 25 minutes, so the CI duration is the thing to watch) and observability (needs its own Redis; a temporary instance on 26316 was started and stopped). One failure, cmdb/host TestHostStateVersionBackfillEnablesCAS, was an artifact of the simulation: the time_zone parameter breaks golang-migrate's own connection string (Error 1298). The same test passes with a plain DSN (7.7s).
18 pass. The new test 'backend tests provide MySQL and Redis and refuse to skip database tests' pins the MySQL service, DSN, DSN_REQUIRED, Redis address and REDIS_REQUIRED.
